card.name: The digit 1 in concentrations and ratios
card.fires_on: The digit 1 when it starts a number, mainly in strengths and ratios such as 1 mg/mL, 1:200,000 or 1:1000. It also fires on 1 in percentages like 1% or 1 percent.

modes.label: Strength or ratio
modes.description: The digit 1 opens a drug concentration or dilution ratio.

modes.label: Concentration in mg/mL
modes.description: The digit 1 gives a per-mL strength in parentheses after a total amount.

modes.label: One percent
modes.description: The digit 1 appears before a percent sign or the word percent, in drug or general text.

card.plain: It lights up on the number 1 at the start of a strength, ratio or percentage, as in 1 mg/mL or 1:1000.
